test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Telugu movie RRR created history by winning a Golden Globe for the Natu Natu song composed by whom among the following personalities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MM Keeravani.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** M. M. Keeravani:-**

 
 
• He is a well-known Indian film composer and playback singer in the Telugu and Hindi film industries.
 
• He has composed music for a wide range of movies and is particularly known for his work in the Indian cinema.
 
• Some of his notable works include the background score and songs for films like "Baahubali: The Beginning," "Baahubali: The Conclusion," "Magadheera," "Pelli Sandadi," and many others.
 
• **He won a Golden Globe for the Natu Natu song.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****The Golden Globe Awards:-**

 
 
• It is an annual awards ceremony that honors outstanding achievements in film and television, both domestic and foreign.
 
• The awards are presented by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association (HFPA), an organization of journalists and photographers who cover entertainment in the United States for international media outlets.
 
• The Golden Globes are considered one of the major awards shows in the entertainment industry, alongside events like the Oscars (Academy Awards) and the Emmys.
